fields.heading: interim-President
fields.subtitle: Question
fields.question:
Double-dipping:
acceptable or unforgivable
?
fields.answer:
As for double-dipping, in the words of
George Costanza, “so??... you dip the way
you want to dip, and I dip the way I want to
dip.”  Double, triple it is all good.
